name: Almond Joy Cookies
subtitle: From Geri
notes: How can you go wrong with chocolate and coconut?

steps.title: Combine the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine and set aside: **4½ cups flour**, **2 tsp baking soda** and **1 tsp salt**.

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugar
steps.body: In a large bowl, cream together: **1 cup butter**, **1½ cups white sugar** and **1½ cups brown sugar**.

steps.title: Add the eggs
steps.body: Beat in, one at a time: **4 eggs**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Stir in the dry ingredients until well mixed.

steps.title: Add the mix-ins
steps.body: Then add: **5 cups chocolate chips**, **2 cups sweetened coconut** and **2 cups chopped almonds**.

steps.title: Drop and bake
steps.body: Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375°F for 8 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.
